One of the Stone Summit dwarves outside of Darkrime Delves gives the following speech when approached: :''"This may be the resting place of [[Hammer of Kathandrax|Kathandrax's Crusher]] or the [[Anvil of Dragrimmar]]."'' :''"It would strike a crippling blow to those pathetic Deldrimor if we were to deny them such prizes."'' :''"If the relics lie within, they will be ours for the taking!"'' :''"We will muster our forces and push onwards."'' :''"Kill anything that stands in your way!"'' ==Notes== {{bug|A [[locked chest]] will occasionally spawn behind the zone portal leading to [[Norrhart Domains]]; there is no way to reach it.}} *{{Vanquisher|count = 236|low = 220|high = 252}} ** Be mindful of [[Wurm]] and [[Mandragor]] pop-ups. ** [[Lord Glacius the Eternal]] appears only as your party approaches its spawn location amongst a group of [[Stone Summit Gnasher]]s. **Consider vanquishing this area with the quest [[Leader of the Pack]] active. Although it will increase the amount of foes you must kill ([[Destroyer]]s), you'll also gain one [[Alpha Tundra Wolf]] and five [[Tundra Wolf]] allies that will follow your party, even after you defeat all of the Destroyers. ==Trivia== {{gw2w}} * The dialogue of the third Stone Summit Gnasher quotes the [[w:Buffy the Vampire Slayer|Buffy the Vampire Slayer]] character Rupert Giles during the episode [[w:Fear, Itself|Fear, Itself]] when he encounters a small demon. {{Explorable areas in the Far Shiverpeaks}} [[de:Bjora-Sümpfe]]
